The short version

Still one of the best-kept secrets in blues and folk

“The blues is an elemental building block of music.”Jon Lawton, in a 2014 interview

He's been playing guitar since the eighth grade, and classical piano even earlier, a discipline he says he mostly resented at the time. A cousin's tickets to see the Rolling Stones and the Grateful Dead pulled him toward the blues in his teens, growing up amid the orange groves of early-1960s Orange County, and he's been chasing that shuffle ever since, picking up fingerstyle blues, a little banjo, and some slide Dobro along the way.
